new_value: render_get now returns Result<GetResponse, Error> (payload encoding failure surfaces as Err, not a silent empty listing) and get_by_id returns the new PickupOutcome::InternalError (5.00, code::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR = 160) instead of masking an invariant violation as empty 2.05 Content. Both sites are unreachable while store invariants hold (records are decode-validated at insert, so re-encode cannot fail) — docs state this and the outcomes exist to keep the API honest when the invariant breaks. Chose error-outcome over debug_assert! because a debug-only assert still masks in release. Grep-verified render_get/get_by_id/PickupOutcome have no callers outside lichen-client + its test, so the signature/enum changes are contained. New pin test internal_error_outcome_maps_to_500 (response_code == 160). Verified: cargo test -p lichen-client --lib 130 passed, deaddrop_vectors 25 passed. Commit + bd flat files.
